lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 6-7 observable vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the circular clusters, forming a grid pattern on the posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance (dorsal) to low-luminance (ventral) along its axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs within the observable proximal silhouette of the first dorsal fin; distal region is missing or heavily damaged.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial tissue loss and irregular, jagged apical margin on the first dorsal fin, with dark, low-luminance protrusions visible at the site of the truncation.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller, elongated silhouettes with distinct dorsal-ventral orientation (remoras) trailing the main body near the pelvic and caudal regions.
